statement: When a dependent operation's coordinator-local services cache still describes replica_operations quorum as concentrated after physical spread, the quorum-spread admission hold releases only after a cache-bypassing authoritative services-owner observation is complete and proves the ledger spread; genuinely concentrated, incomplete, or unavailable authoritative evidence remains deferred, and the unchanged MovieLens scenario admits the final sql_write_operations replica.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Repair only release confirmation for an already-engaged cache-local ledger quorum-spread hold. Reuse the canonical services-owner read and existing row-set placement evaluator; do not add a timer, retry loop, cache, reconciliation worker, or second concentration predicate.

A dependent move releases only when every locally spread-actionable ledger partition has a complete cache-bypassing owner observation that proves spread. Authoritatively concentrated, incomplete, malformed, unavailable, or failed observations remain deferred. Do not change quorum arithmetic, voter roles, target replica counts, hold engagement rows, cure exemptions, self-move serialization, remove safety, or operation budgets.

When cache-local actuals do not engage the quorum-spread hold, preserve the existing no-read admission path. The authoritative owner read is a bounded re-verification of a positive local hold, not a new unconditional admission dependency.

Remote confirmation must use the services-table owner path with owner-RPC preference and no SQL fallback; an owner-local authoritative answer remains valid when the coordinator is itself the owner. Generic cache-first or SQL-projection success must not release the hold.

Before live validation, reproduce through the real RebalanceCoordinator admission path that stale locally concentrated services rows defer on current source even though complete authoritative rows prove three voters on three nodes. Prove the fix red on exact source revert, and cover genuinely concentrated, partial, unavailable, and multi-ledger evidence plus the no-local-hold no-read path.

After deterministic and focused proof, run the unchanged five-node formation probe once and then at most one changed full MovieLens scenario. Preserve stopped-state evidence and do not rerun unchanged bytes after a red.
